2608.16428.title: Visualizing Uncertainty-to-Action Composition for Human Oversight
2608.16428.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence systems often disclose uncertainty, yet they rarely make clear what response that uncertainty should trigger. Most uncertainty visualizations encode uncertainty in model outputs, leaving users to discern the most appropriate course of action. A second region of the design space--uncertainty in the decision process itself, including how multiple uncertainty conditions compose into an oversight response-- remains comparatively underexplored. We address this gap with two coupled contributions. First, we introduce an uncertainty-to-action binding framework that composes multiple uncertainty conditions into a single oversight response under a precedence policy with a contextual safety modifier. That response concerns whether and how an AI-supported decision may proceed, not the substantive domain decision itself. Second, we present ActionCue, a process-transparency visualization that renders that composition explicit. We demonstrate the approach through a three-way comparison with confidence-only and data-level uncertainty displays, using worked cases from healthcare, credit assessment, and disaster forecasting. Together, the framework specifies how uncertainty conditions are resolved into an oversight response, and the visualization makes that resolution inspectable rather than implicit.
2608.16428.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧系統經常顯示不確定性，但它們很少明確說明這種不確定性應該觸發什麼樣的回應。大多數不確定性視覺化將不確定性編碼在模型輸出中，讓使用者自行判斷最合適的行動方案。設計空間的第二個區域——決策過程本身的不確定性，包括多個不確定性條件如何組成監督回應——相對於其他領域仍然未被充分探索。我們通過兩個相互關聯的貢獻來填補這一空白。首先，我們介紹了一個不確定性到行動的綁定框架，該框架在具有上下文安全修飾符的優先政策下，將多個不確定性條件組合成一個單一的監督回應。該回應關注的是AI支持的決策是否以及如何進行，而不是實質領域的決策本身。其次，我們呈現了ActionCue，一種過程透明度的視覺化，將這種組合明確化。我們通過與僅信心和數據級不確定性顯示的三方比較來展示這一方法，使用來自醫療保健、信用評估和災難預測的案例。總體而言，該框架指定了不確定性條件如何解決為監督回應，而視覺化則使該解決過程可檢查，而非隱含。
